title: The Panel
question: What exactly is in this file?
goals: Learn the columns, then load and look.
Know who built the file and how.
Check the flag and add the industry codes.
See who enters, who leaves, and when.
Measure late arrivals, short histories, and gaps.
Profile the companies by size, losses, and industry.
Find the columns that repeat other columns.
Draw a signed number on a signed scale.
Name what the file cannot tell us.

columns.name: Counting columns as information
columns.naive_label: Columns of accounts in the file
columns.why: The other columns are copies or exact arithmetic on these, so they add nothing new.
